hints.title: Recursive Permutation Tree
hints.text: Use recursion to generate permutations of numbers from 1 to n.

hints.title: Parity Alternation Guard
hints.text: Check that each newly placed number has different parity from its immediate predecessor.

hints.title: Ordered Exploration
hints.text: Iterate through candidate values in ascending order to guarantee lexicographical sorting.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Backtracks over available digits, pruning paths where adjacent parity matches.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations and filtering post-hoc explores excessive invalid states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion depth and visited bitmask are bounded by n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies backtracking with state-pruning and natural lexicographical iteration.
